name: current-base-apexpages-residual-runtime-api67
salesforceExclusionReason: Knowledge and Visualforce controller actions use Glade's local Knowledge__kav and page-reference model; the scratch org has no portable Knowledge data for hosted runtime proof.

source.content: @isTest private class CurrentBaseApexPagesResidualRuntimeTest { @isTest static void residualControllerActions() { Knowledge__kav article = new Knowledge__kav(Title = 'Fixture Article'); ApexPages.KnowledgeArticleVersionStandardController knowledge = new ApexPages.KnowledgeArticleVersionStandardController(article); knowledge.addFields(new List<String>{'Title'}); knowledge.setDataCategory('Products', 'Trail'); System.assertEquals(article, knowledge.getRecord()); System.assertEquals(article.Id, knowledge.getId()); System.assertNotEquals(null, knowledge.view()); System.assertNotEquals(null, knowledge.cancel()); Account account = new Account(Name = 'Quick Save'); ApexPages.StandardController standard = new ApexPages.StandardController(account); System.assertNotEquals(null, standard.quickSave()); } }
